definitions.explanation: An act that is morally or legally wrong. Can range from minor misconduct to serious crimes. Commonly appears in the proverb {悪事|あくじ}{千里|せんり}を{走|はし}る (bad news travels fast).

examples.japanese: {悪事|あくじ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いつか⟦{露見|ろけん}→露見：20077_roken⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Wrongdoing will come to light eventually.

examples.japanese: 「{悪事|あくじ}{千里|せんり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧」⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{諺|ことわざ}→諺：02765_kotowaza⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a proverb: 'Bad news travels a thousand miles.'

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたる{悪事|あくじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついに⟦{発覚|はっかく}→発覚：07629_hakkaku⟧し、⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}った→失う：01887_ushinau⟧。
examples.english: Years of misconduct were finally exposed, and the company lost its credibility.

notes:
Compound of {悪|あく} (evil, bad) + {事|じ} (matter, act). A formal, slightly literary term for immoral or criminal acts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {悪事|あくじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to commit wrongdoing
- {悪事|あくじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{露見|ろけん}→露見：20077_roken⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: wrongdoing comes to light
- {悪事|あくじ}{千里|せんり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧: bad news travels fast (proverb)
- {悪事|あくじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{加担|かたん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to participate in wrongdoing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{悪行|あくぎょう}→悪行：23069_akugyou⟧: wrongdoing, evil conduct — similar, slightly more formal
- ⟦{不正|ふせい}→不正：01660_fusei⟧: irregularity, misconduct — more common in administrative or legal contexts
- ⟦{罪|つみ}→罪：03532_tsumi⟧: sin, crime, fault — broader; includes legal, moral, and religious senses
